$comment: Prose sidecar for scripts/classify-permit-phase.descriptor.json (Spec 120 §3.4-§3.4b; C6-2 commit ②, 2026-10-25).
CAP: 12 prose entries across the NOTES_PROSE_BLOCKS (scripts/analysis/gates/notes-cap.mjs; fast invariant #45). PROMOTE to a check or DELETE; there is no overflow.
No live-table number below was measured by this lane (no DB access); M1-M3 are queued for night N-A (assessment §9).

read_this_way.what: 'Examination' is a derived enriched_status, never a raw status. The CKAN feed labels permits in the city's examination pipeline (zoning review, code review) as status 'Inspection' with no issued_date (c6bf9f1d; about 13,764 such permits when the step was written, header :5-7, documented, not re-measured). The step writes enriched_status only, so the loader upsert keeps the raw status; the other half of the contract is in the four permits.status writers, which clear enriched_status when the status leaves 'Inspection' (C7, Spec 44 §3).

measured.query: read of the frozen oracle (sha256 f952f0cb47a905e1...) and the status writers at d6dc90d2

read_this_way.what: examination_classified is the rows THIS run changed and is 0 on a rerun (the guard); total_examination / total_inspection / examination_rate are cumulative over every base-revision 'Inspection' permit, and the denominator has no issued_date clause, so the rate is the share of the whole Inspection population that is in examination. records_total is the eligible pool (f2724308), not the changed rows.

known_normal.what: A steady-state run changes zero rows and reads PASS: new 'Examination' rows appear only when the loader brings a new base-revision 'Inspection' permit with no issued_date, or clears enriched_status on a status change that later returns to 'Inspection'.

blind_spots.what: CPP-D6: nothing clears 'Examination' when a permit gains a real issued_date while its feed status stays 'Inspection' (no reverse arm; the loader keeps enriched_status while status stays 'Inspection'). The live count is M2 (night N-A); a correction needs its own R-HQ entry.
The four rows are INFO with no bound (CPP-D2): a collapse of the eligible pool or of the rate does not WARN. No bound is invented without a measured baseline (M1).

decisions.what: Vocabulary constants, not tunables (CPP-D3): the CKAN status word 'Inspection', the derived value 'Examination' and the base revision key '00' (sub-revisions inherit lifecycle state from the base permit, 3a074eea). The epoch-default cutoff is the pinned variable classify_permit_phase_issued_date_floor_year (1970, min = max, a definitional constant, Spec 132 §core.8): issued_date <= 1 January of that year counts as no issued date. issued_date is a DATE column, so this selects the same rows as the legacy issued_date < '1970-01-02'.

The permits.last_seen_at bump (CPP-D1) is kept at ② as a declared deviation (card CPP-Q1, option A, HELD for the operator): written:"step", source:"run_at", outside the guard, never written:"seen" (Spec 132 §core.14 (R-FF)). Whether it retires is decided after the night N-A redundancy count M3.

fences.incident: the LG-9 run-clock trap (geocode_permits): a source:"run_at" column in the guard is distinct on every run and would rewrite every eligible permit every run.
